mapper.sql: p.id, p.type, p.slug, p.title, p.summary, p.content, c.slug AS categorySlug, c.name AS categoryName, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.slug ORDER BY t.slug SEPARATOR '|||') AS tagSlugs, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.name ORDER BY t.name SEPARATOR '|||') AS tagNames, p.published_at AS publishedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM post p LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN post_tag pt ON pt.post_id = p.id LEFT JOIN tag t ON t.id = pt.tag_id WHERE p.id > #{lastId} AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.published_at IS NOT NULL AND p.published_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) GROUP BY p.id, p.type, p.slug, p.title, p.summary, p.content, c.slug, c.name, p.published_at ORDER BY p.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM post p LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN post_tag pt ON pt.post_id = p.id LEFT JOIN tag t ON t.id = pt.tag_id WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.published_at IS NOT NULL AND p.published_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) GROUP BY p.id, p.type, p.slug, p.title, p.summary, p.content, c.slug, c.name, p.published_at LIMIT 1
